Usage: prime teams list [OPTIONS]

  List teams for the current user.

Options:
  --limit INTEGER    Maximum number of teams to list  [default: 100]
  --offset INTEGER   Number of teams to skip  [default: 0]
  -o, --output TEXT  Output format: table or json  [default: table]
  --plain            Use plain, terse outputs. USE THIS IF YOU ARE AI.
  -h, --help         Show this message and exit.

  JSON output (--output json): .teams[] = {teamId, name, slug, role,
  createdAt} .total_count = number
